boss_superior.source: R2:L13789 ('The 10th house has reference to the employer'); R6:L6503 (10th-house list: 'employer, superior, master, judge')

business_partner.source: R2:L12978-12985 (7th house: 'the partner in trade or business and the degree of success achieved through such partnership is also shown by this house')

children.source: R3:L9138-9139 ('child by 5th house'); R6:L12045-12049 (horary: 'If it refers to children take the 5th as lagna')

competitor_enemy_open.source: R2:L12978-12985 (7th: 'his rival in any contest ... his public adversaries'); R6:L12086 ('As the opponent is shown by the 7th house')

elder_sibling.source: R6:L12048-12049 (horary: 'to elder brother or sister take the 11th'); R5:L992 ('11th house shows elder brother')

father.source: R3:L9138-9139 ('Father by 9th house'); R6:L12045-12049 (horary: 'to father take 9th'); R2:L13307 (9th: 'Pithru (father)')

friend.source: R2:L13921-13935 (11th: 'the house of friends ... one's favourites ... associates, advisers, adherents, supporters, well-wishers')

guru_teacher.source: R2:L13307-13310 (9th: 'Acharva (guru or preceptor)'). Note: citation names guru/preceptor; 'teacher/coach' extended by same office, marked reasonable but not verbatim.

mother.source: R3:L9138 ('Mother is shown by 4th house'); R6:L12045-12049 (horary: 'If the query relates to mother, take the fourth house')

secret_enemy.source: R2:L15000-15004 (12th: 'persecution by secret enemies' — quoted via L. George, carried as accepted doctrine in the book). Not Krishnamurti's own phrasing; marked near-verbatim.

self.source: R2:L12013-12015 ('The first house or what is commonly known as the Ascendant (Lagna) signifies the native')

spouse_partner.source: R2:L12937-12945 (7th: 'Kalathra (wife or husband)'); R6:L12045-12049 (horary: 'To wife take 7th')

stranger_unknown.source: R6:L8695-8700 — Krishnamurti's own ruling: 'I do not agree. Because according to me all people not related to the native should be judged from the 9th house.' Also R6:L8697-8699 (KP method: 'For father and for strangers take only the 9th house.')

thief.source: R2:L13041-13046 (7th-house section: 'The 7th shows thief. The 8th bhava being 2 to the 7th indicates the thief's wealth.')

younger_sibling.source: R6:L12045 ('for younger sister or brother, take the 3rd house counted from Horary lagna as the Ascendant')

romantic_partner.source: USER-RULING Rule 2 (2026-09-28): romance/pre-legal bucket -> 5th; 5th = love/romance per R6:L6213 'ROMANCE (LOVE AFFAIRS)'

brother_in_law.source: OURS 2026-09-29 (Bhavat-Bhavam): spouse's brother=3rd from 7th = 9th (also sister's husband=7th from 3rd = 9th)
